customManagers.description: Base image in build.yaml. The `-pg18` tag suffix is treated as compatibility, so PostgreSQL majors (which need a data migration) are never proposed.
TimescaleDB version shown to users (README table, DOCS intro, app store description). Tracks the `-pg18` image tag, so it moves in the same grouped PR as build.yaml.
Versions annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the preceding line (build.yaml args, apk pins in the Dockerfile and verify-restore.sh)

packageRules.description: pgbackrest is installed from Alpine edge/community (Dockerfile, verify-restore.sh). Read edge's APKINDEX directly instead of Repology, whose lookups fail from Renovate. The x86_64 index stands in for all arches: edge builds them from one APKBUILD.
The dockerfile manager also extracts the `apk add pkg=ver` pin, duplicating the `# renovate:` annotated one; the regex manager owns it so Dockerfile and verify-restore.sh bump in one branch
s6-overlay uses 4-part versions (3.2.2.0), which semver rejects
Both arches pin the same image; bump them in one PR
